resources.string: ZedMarket needs your location to show listings near you.
Allow ZedMarket to access your location?
Turn on Location for ZedMarket, then press Back.
Location is allowed now — tap Use current location again.
Turn on Location, then come back and try again.

Get notified when you have a new message.
